capabilities: Number all headings in a document with outline-style numbers
Remove numbering from all headings in a document
Save numbering settings to document front matter
Skip specific headings or heading levels via a skip setting
Render an automatic table of contents
extras: The credits section mentions inspiration from another Obsidian plugin, but its name was a link and is not given in the README text. Detailed settings instructions are deferred to the plugin's settings page.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically number or re-number headings in an outline style.
summary: Heading numbering tool that adds and maintains outline-style numbers (like 1.1.2) on headings in a document via commands.
